描述_EN: this vessel was a container for grain. metalworkers in ancient china made a great variety of food and wine containers in bronze for ritual use. each vessel had a specific name according to its shape and function. they became treasured objects of antiquarian scholars and collectors when they were accidentally unearthed centuries later. these vessels were buried with the dead.
描述_ZN: 该器皿是装粮食的容器。 古代中国的金属工匠用青铜制作了大量的食物和酒的容器，供祭祀使用。 每个容器根据其形状和功能都有一个特定的名字。 它们在几百年后意外出土时，成为了古董学者和收藏家的珍品。 这些器皿与死者埋在一起。
